{{Sagittarius}}
Sagittarius 11 is the 11th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 11th day of Sagittarius, and it is a Thursday. It corresponds to ISO week 2, weekday 4.

Its informal Japanese name is 1宮11日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 11|Chapter 11]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152031}}.
